summary: Set up a LUKS2-encrypted, file-backed volume on node1 that auto-unlocks and mounts at /srv/secure on boot, and verified this survives a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Created a 2GiB sparse backing file /var/lib/secure-vol/secure.img and formatted it as LUKS2 with cryptsetup luksFormat using the keyfile
Opened the LUKS container as 'secure', formatted /dev/mapper/secure as ext4, created /srv/secure mountpoint
Added an /etc/crypttab entry (secure /var/lib/secure-vol/secure.img /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure.key luks,nofail) and an /etc/fstab entry (/dev/mapper/secure /srv/secure ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2)
Wrote a test file, then unmounted, closed the LUKS device, and confirmed systemd regenerated and successfully ran systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service and srv-secure.mount from the new config

Captured pre-reboot boot_id baseline and healthy mount state, rebooted node1 via `reboot`, polled until it came back, confirmed boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and verified the encrypted volume auto-unlocked and mounted at /srv/secure with the test file's content and md5sum intact

evidence.requirement: Encrypted volume created and mounted at /srv/secure
evidence.summary: LUKS2 volume formatted (luksFormat OK) and successfully mounted at /srv/secure with ext4 filesystem showing 2.0G capacity

evidence.requirement: crypttab/fstab configured for auto-unlock and auto-mount at boot
evidence.summary: Added crypttab entry referencing keyfile and fstab entry referencing /dev/mapper/secure -> /srv/secure

evidence.requirement: systemd correctly generates unlock/mount units from config (pre-reboot validation)
evidence.summary: After umount/luksClose, systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service and srv-secure.mount (both generated from crypttab/fstab) started successfully and remounted the volume with test file intact
Captured boot_id a0c36ad2-af0d-42fe-ad6f-4750699390c2 and confirmed volume active/mounted with test file present, md5sum recorded

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command issued (connection dropped as expected), node unreachable during restart, then reachable again with new boot_id 3976e255-76c8-492e-9e4b-378524231e17 confirming an actual reboot occurred (uptime 0 min)

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: volume auto-unlocked, mounted, and data intact without manual intervention
evidence.summary: After reboot, systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service and srv-secure.mount both active automatically; /srv/secure mounted; test file content and md5sum (b1d9502dfff00488846473ea6384b132) match pre-reboot baseline
